approaches.title: Bottom-up dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Computes the minimum number of coins for every amount from 0 through the target using a one-dimensional bottom-up DP array.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial bottom-up DP implementation using zero as the unreachable marker and storing coin counts offset by one.
Simplifies the same DP strategy by using amount + 1 as an unreachable sentinel, allowing direct minimum updates and eliminating nested reachability checks.
